findings.claim: Generated formatter for contractless types is built with default MessagePackSecurity behavior; no new bypass. However, the generator calls GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect twice (model path and diagnostics path) and any exception inside Collect (e.g. GetMemberType throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException, ElementAt on formatterInterfaces, cast `(INamedTypeSymbol)context.TargetSymbol`) is unguarded and would crash the generator, silently dropping all generated formatters and resolver registrations. Contractless members use ObjectSerializationInfo with constructorParameters empty; for classes with required/init-only members the generated code may not satisfy security-relevant validation, but nothing security specific found.

receipt_plan.detail: Read GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect and MessagePackGenerator.cs generatedFormatters pipeline: no try/catch around Collect; confirm no reachable throw with attacker-controlled input (inputs are compile-time source only).
